name: expskill
description: Eight independent skills and one optional lifecycle router.

interface.shortDescription: Standalone development skills with optional routing
interface.longDescription: Use $brainstorm, $plan, $design, $implement, $test, $skill-builder, $unslop, or $grill-me directly. $skill-builder creates or improves one exact agent skill with evidence gates. Use $use-expskill to select the next lifecycle step while preserving implementation review and specification gates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $use-expskill to select and explain the next lifecycle step for my code change.
